name: It could be worse!
source: To be too much self-confident is worth nothing, because the wheel can turn. Neither is tempting the devil, because this bastard often plays bad tricks. And above all, never bet what you might regret! But that's what Natasha's future husband did. And now it's up to her to avoid trouble. But will she really want to, facing such a handsome devil?
translation: 过于自信是没有任何价值的，因为车轮是可以转动的。也不是诱惑魔鬼，因为这个混蛋经常耍坏伎俩。最重要的是，永远不要下注你可能会后悔的事情！但这就是娜塔莎未来丈夫所做的。现在该由她来避免麻烦了。但面对如此帅气的恶魔，她真的愿意吗？
